reaction_forces.description: Value of the reaction forces at the imposed displacement location

position_profile_for_deflection.description: Positions along the beam axis where the deflection is sampled.

location_max_deflection.description: Position along the beam axis of the deflection of largest magnitude.

deflection_profile.description: Deflection of the neutral fibre, at the positions position_profile_for_deflection.

moment_profile.description: Bending moment at the breakpoints position_profile_for_moment; the moment is linear between two breakpoints.

position_profile_for_moment.description: Positions along the beam axis of the breakpoints of the piecewise-linear bending moment, not a dense sampling.

deflection_at_load_point.description: Deflection at the location of the load.
